properties.title: SNF Ticket Transcript Generator Lambda Errors

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/production-rec-lambda-snf-tickets-transcript-generator' | fields @timestamp, @message 
| filter level="ERROR" or @message like /(?i)\bError\b/ and @message like "Got Error"
| parse @message /Got Error:(?<error_txt>[^"]+)/ 
| stats
count(*) - sum(strcontains(error_txt, "Cannot convert undefined or null to object")) - sum(strcontains(error_txt, "Cannot read properties of undefined")) - sum(strcontains(error_txt, "No JSON files found in folderKeyPrefix")) - sum(strcontains(error_txt, "Unexpected behavior !")) - sum(strcontains(error_txt, "UnRetryableError")) as other_errors,
sum(strcontains(error_txt, "UnRetryableError")) as unretryable_errors,
sum(strcontains(error_txt, "Cannot convert undefined or null to object")) as cannot_convert_undefined_to_object,
sum(strcontains(error_txt, "Cannot read properties of undefined")) as cannot_read_properties_undefined,
sum(strcontains(error_txt, "No JSON files found in folderKeyPrefix")) as no_json_files_found_folderKeyPrefix,
sum(strcontains(error_txt, "Unexpected behavior !")) as unexpected_behavior,
count(*) as total_errors
